title: Customer Account Terms: Paying the Rental Share and Credits (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Terms.** The customer's share of a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, being the customer's charges less the customer's payments and credits over the life of the reservation, is paid at settlement on an accepted card, after which the card hold is released; an overpayment is refunded within the class refund period in business days.

## Credits

Credits name the charge they reduce and never exceed it.

| Credit reason | What it does |
|---|---|
| Customer-pay discount | Follows the settlement split of the final invoice |
| Billing error | Corrects a wrong charge |
| Goodwill | Credited as goodwill on the rental |

## Clause no longer in force

The clause under which goodwill is capped at the class goodwill credit authority in rental days at the class's partner rate per rental, measured by the goodwill already credited on the rental, beyond which the request is declined, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer's charges on a rental come to 180.00 USD and a 20.00 USD credit stands against them: the share paid at settlement is 160.00 USD, after which the card hold is released.
- A customer who paid 160.00 USD on a share later reduced to 140.00 USD by a billing-error credit has overpaid 20.00 USD, refunded within the class refund period.
- A billing-error credit of 60.00 USD against a 50.00 USD charge would exceed the charge it names, which credits never do.

superseded_clauses: goodwill is capped at goodwill_credit_authority_days rental days at the class's partner rate per rental (rental_msr_goodwill_credited), beyond which the request is declined
